text:
MechaNika | Official Trailer | Crunchyroll Game Vault
MechaNika is a dark comedy point-and-click adventure starring Nika, a brilliant seven-year-old who is completely done with the boring world around her.

🎮 Play MechaNika from Crunchyroll Games through Crunchyroll Game Vault! https://crgames.sng.link/Dk3aj/6s8i/wi93

Her parents barely notice her. Her teacher does not understand her. Her brother spends his time playing video games, and school never seems to teach the things she actually cares about, including energy transfer, magnetic fields, and electrical engineering.

Nika decides to fix the problem herself. Her answer is Project MechaNika, a plan to build a giant combat mech and get rid of everything she considers dull, pointless, or uncool. Armed with a backpack full of tools, a sharp mind, and a specific vision for a better world, she sets out to find the parts she needs and put her machine together.

DARK COMEDY AND SATIRE
Follow a story filled with dark humor, cynical observations, strange situations, and pop-culture references. Nika sees the world differently from the adults around her, and every conversation reveals more of her ambitious plan.

SOLVE CLEVER POINT-AND-CLICK PUZZLES
Explore each location, examine your surroundings, talk to characters, and collect useful objects. Combine items, uncover clues, and solve logic and inventory puzzles to keep Project MechaNika moving forward.

Some challenges require careful observation. Others ask you to think creatively about the tools and information Nika has collected. Every solved puzzle brings her one step closer to completing the mech.

BUILD PROJECT MECHANIKA
Search for the components Nika needs to bring her design to life. Track down parts, figure out how they fit together, and work through obstacles standing between Nika and her finished machine.

As the project grows, so does the scale of her plan. What starts close to home soon expands to school, the city, and everything else Nika thinks could use an upgrade.

EXPLORE A HAND-DRAWN 2D WORLD
Travel through colorful hand-drawn locations packed with small details, visual jokes, hidden references, and unexpected characters. The bright art style creates a sharp contrast with Nika's dark sense of humor and destructive ambitions.

Meet eccentric family members, classmates, neighbors, and other unusual people along the way. Each character has a story to uncover and may hold information or items that help Nika continue her mission.

FIND EASTER EGGS AND SECRETS
Look closely for references to video games, anime, movies, music, and other pieces of pop culture hidden throughout the world. Explore every area to find optional details, jokes, and secrets beyond the main story.

Listen to an original soundtrack created to match Nika's chaotic journey.

A STORY-RICH SINGLE-PLAYER ADVENTURE
MechaNika brings together puzzle solving, exploration, dark comedy, and a memorable female protagonist in one story-driven indie adventure. If you enjoy brain teasers, unusual characters, hand-drawn worlds, and stories that get weird, Nika's mission has plenty to discover.

WELCOME TO THE PSYCHOTIC UNIVERSE
Created by indie developer Mango Protocol, MechaNika is the first adventure in the Psychotic Universe. The game introduces the world, characters, and dark comedic style that continue in Agatha Knife.

Help Nika gather the pieces, solve the puzzles, finish her mech, and find out how far Project MechaNika can go.
